subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

No changes can be made to the bond without the _________ of the partners.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'consent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us explore the** meaning **of the given **options : **
 
• ** Sympathy**: It is a feeling of pity or a sense of compassion. 
 
• ** Harmony**: a state of agreement or of peaceful existence together.
 
• ** Confession**: an act of admitting that you have done something bad or wrong.
 
• ** Consent **: to give assent or approval.
 
• From the above-given meanings of the given options, it is clear that the marked option** 'consent' **is the right word to fill in the given blank as it conveys the right sense of the sentence.

Thus, the correct answer is** option 4.**
